claim_records.uncertainty: The corpus is deliberately small and purposive. The Chasing project's statement about low standing among musicians and average listeners is a producer self-description rather than an independent population measure; Levi represents one professional review; Leech-Wilkinson and Mattes document scholarly uptake but do not quantify wider musician, audience, sales or programming reception.
claim_records.prohibited_inference: The sources do not establish a general change in Grieg's public reputation, consensus among critics or musicians, sales impact, aesthetic superiority of a restoration, or that Chasing the Butterfly alone caused later scholarly or performance-practice change.

resolved: The selected direct reception object has a persistent HTTPS page with reviewer Erik Levi, publication date 20 January 2012, label Simax and catalogue PSC 1299.
The review directly foregrounds the restored nine Grieg 1903 acoustic recordings, while the Chasing project independently documents its producer-framed reception problem and remediation aim.
Independent peer-reviewed uptake is controlled through Leech-Wilkinson's 2012 MTO discussion of the Chasing online study/CD and Mattes' later 2020 research use of remastered Grieg recordings.

The corpus limit is explicit: project self-description, one professional review and two scholarly uses cannot establish population reception, consensus, sales, aesthetic value or single-cause status change.
Rights are conservatively resolved for History Go use: no reuse license for the review text is identified, therefore only external-link-and-metadata access is released.
direct_object_gate.release_rule: Only the bounded claim that the Grieg 1903 recordings became active objects in these identified producer, professional-review and scholarly channels may drive questions. Preserve the corpus limits, do not infer general audience/critic/musician reception or aesthetic value, and keep the review external-link-and-metadata-only.

coverage.known_gap: This production verifies one small reception/remediation corpus around the Grieg 1903 recordings and Chasing/SIMAX release. It does not establish aggregate audience, musician, critic, sales, programming or streaming reception; it does not compare a systematic sample of reviews; and it does not claim that Chasing alone caused later research or performance-practice change.
